description: SC Companion — Angular 21 PWA on 127.0.0.1:4200. Responsive verification is delegated to the machine-checkable mobile gate (scripts/mobile-gate.mjs) instead of eyeballing screenshots.

tool_chain.purpose: Start the Angular dev server if it is not already listening. IPv4 only — see .claude/deep-knowledge/local-dev.md (localhost != 127.0.0.1 here).

tool_chain.tool: $BROWSER_TOOL probe — Chrome-MCP (Edge, if connected) → Preview → Playwright
tool_chain.purpose: Resolve the active browser tool for structured reads. Never computer-use.
Verify DOM content, element presence and ARIA state on the changed route
Catch runtime JS errors and failed/4xx/5xx requests the snapshot cannot reveal

tool_chain.tool: Bash(npm run gate:mobile:quick)  — full `npm run gate:mobile` before shipping
tool_chain.purpose: Machine-checked phone + tablet verification: iPhone 14 390x844 (iOS), Pixel 7 393x851 (Android), iPad Air 820x1180 (iOS), Galaxy Tab S9 800x1280 (Android). Asserts no horizontal overflow, tap targets >= 44px, text >= 12px, no clipped/overlapping content, no fixed bar covering a control, zoomable viewport meta, no console errors. Non-zero exit = red; do NOT relax thresholds. Docs: docs/mobile-gate.md
Desktop layout — the one viewport the mobile gate deliberately does not cover
